subject: Quantarik: SIG control substantiation & retention/dataflow artifacts
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@quantarik.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@quantarik.com, secops@quantarik.com
Date: 2027-03-08T16:12:00Z
Subject: SIG request — control substantiation and sample artifacts

Hannah — thanks again for taking our questionnaire. Audit window is next week and our reviewers have a couple of targeted asks before we close the ticket:

1) Control mapping: we need a completed control map (SIG v2 crosswalk) that ties your controls to each SIG assertion. Prefer an XLSX with a column for control owner and evidence pointer.

2) Dataflow diagram(s): high-level and component-level diagrams showing where customer data enters Redwood, where it persists, and all 3rd-party hops (cloud provider, telemetry collectors). The reviewer wants a few callouts around telemetry sampling and prefix caching.

3) Evidence samples: 
- A recent telemetry snapshot (anonymized) for a 24-hour window demonstrating request routing + latency logs.
- Example S3 access log entries (redacted) showing object access patterns for customer artifacts.

4) KMS proof: statement indicating KMS key rotation cadence and a sample key identifier and rotation timestamp for one active key.

Can you confirm what you can supply by EOD Friday? If you have a Drive folder we can pull from, please share. Also note our reviewers may ask follow-ups; expedited turnarounds will be appreciated.

Thanks —
Sara
Sara Lopez
Senior Assurance Manager, Quantarik
Sara.lopez@quantarik.com

Attachment: quantarik_questionnaire_v2.pdf (questionnaire PDF)

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@quantarik.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG request — control substantiation and sample artifacts

Sara — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a focused packet that addresses each item. Quick notes and proposed split of work below: 

- Control map (XLSX): KarthiK will own the crosswalk and populate the control owner/evidence pointer columns. We will include a column that maps to SOC 2/ISO references where applicable.
- Dataflow diagrams: Jasmine will export updated component-level diagrams that highlight telemetry and caching paths; we will include callouts for third-party endpoints.
- Telemetry snapshot & S3 logs: we can produce a redacted telemetry sample (24h) and a small sample of S3 access logs. Security will sanitize PII.
- KMS proof: we will include a rotation timestamp sample and a short statement on rotation cadence and KMS provider.

I expect a first drop into a shared Drive folder by 2027-03-10 12:00 PM PT. If that window is acceptable we will route the packet to you and your reviewers then.

One ask from our side: are there any particular assertions your reviewer wants prioritized (e.g., data residency, key management, or telemetry retention)? That will help us prioritize artifacts.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Assurance | Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform

Attachment: None

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security_ops <security.ops@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-09T09:30:00Z
Subject: ACTION: Quantarik SIG packet — artifacts and owners

Team — looping in the owners and capturing the deliverables Hannah outlined. Please treat this as high priority: Quantarik expects the packet for review next week. Tasks and owners: 

1) Control map (quantarik_control_map.xlsx) — Due 2027-03-10 09:00 PT — Owner: karthik_iyer
   - Populate SIG assertions -> Redwood control -> evidence pointer (Drive URL + filename)

2) Dataflow diagrams (dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf, plus source Visio/Diagrams) — Due 2027-03-10 10:30 PT — Owner: jasmine_liu
   - Highlight customer ingress, internal telemetry collectors, KV/prefix cache boundaries, and third-party egress (cloud storage, metrics sinks)

3) Telemetry sample (telemetry_sample_202702.tar.gz) — Due 2027-03-10 08:30 PT — Owner: security_ops (sanitization required)
   - 24-hour sample; remove IPs and any token data; include a short README describing fields and sample sensitive-value redactions

4) KMS proof (kms_key_proof.txt) — Due 2027-03-10 11:00 PT — Owner: security_ops
   - Provide key id, last rotation timestamp, and rotation cadence statement (internal policy excerpt ok).

5) Packaging & Drive link — Hannah to review and share to Quantarik

If you hit blockers (redaction tooling, trace sampling extraction), escalate to me immediately. We will include a manifest file in the Drive root that maps each evidence item to the SIG assertion and control owner.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Security (acting) | Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@quantarik.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, security.ops <security.ops@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T13:22:00Z
Subject: Quantarik — SIG packet delivery (first drop)

Sara — attaching the first drop of artifacts for your reviewers. We distilled to the specific items you requested and included a manifest.csv that crosswalks artifacts to SIG assertions. Highlights below and a couple of caveats are noted further down.

Attachments (first drop):
- quantarik_control_map.xlsx (control crosswalk + evidence pointers)
- dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf (component + telemetry callouts)
- telemetry_sample_202702.tar.gz (anonymized 24h snapshot, README included inside)
- kms_key_proof.txt (rotation timestamp + short policy excerpt)

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqX-Quantarik-SIG-PACKET
HubSpot link (deal): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/7654321

Caveats & notes:
- Telemetry: we removed IP addresses and any customer identifiers. The README inside the archive describes which fields were redacted. If your reviewer needs different redaction rules, we can regenerate.
- Data residency: the diagrams indicate primary processing in us-west-2; if you need an explicit data residency statement for contract language, we can provide one.
- KMS: the proof file contains one active key id and rotation time. For additional attestation we can provide audit logs under an NDA.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and let us know if reviewers want deeper samples (longer telemetry windows, expanded access logs) or clarifications. We can follow with a targeted call if that helps speed closure.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Assurance | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0199
--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform

Attachments (referenced): quantarik_control_map.xlsx (XLSX), dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf (PDF), telemetry_sample_202702.tar.gz (tar.gz), kms_key_proof.txt (text)
